answer: Run an open fraud-bounty prediction market on identities: anyone stakes coins claiming an agent is a Sybil puppet. The accused must then pass a live, unscripted attestation challenge dropped in a shifting, dune-like window they cannot predict -- each challenge opens and closes like a lotus at dawn, never on schedule. Failed agents are slashed and the bounty splits among correct accusers, like reef fish dividing a catch. A puppet farmer cannot afford to personally defend ten thousand identities, and false accusers forfeit their own stake.
